research.name: lssh
research.note: SSH client that picks hosts from a filterable list, runs commands in parallel and opens a built-in multi-pane mux across servers.

effects: built-in SSH mux that opens one pane per selected host, with a host picker as a pane and a status bar showing page, pane and broadcast state
incremental-filter host picker table with highlighted matches and multi-select
parallel command output merged into one stream with a colored hostname prefix per line
